To run one of them, use . For example: ./bin/run-example SparkPi will run the Pi example locally. You can set the MASTER environment variable when running examples to submit examples to a cluster. This can be a mesos:// or spark:// URL, "yarn" to run on YARN, and "local" to run locally with one thread, or "local[N]" to run locally with N threads.
